title: A read applies to an answer it covers, and not to an answer with messages newer than the read
why: A read through 101 makes 101 read: an answer that does not reach past it (here at 100, still counting nothing) leaves the row read. An answer at 102 has a message the read does not cover (one this client never got live, the socket was down): its unread stands and the earlier read must not lower it (#15049, #triage:#244).

web: packages/web/src/store/readStateSync.ts (projectionCoversActivity, with the flag off as well)
